create_runtime_reward_instance: create a RuntimeReward instance with a runtime count, warmup count, and estimator callable
reset_runtime_reward_benchmark: reset the RuntimeReward for a new benchmark and compute the starting runtime
update_runtime_reward: update the RuntimeReward with new observations and compute the reward delta
review_runtime_reward_estimator: review the RuntimeReward estimator callable that reduces runtime observations to a single float
test_runtime_reward_service_error: test the RuntimeReward update method raises ServiceError when runtime count mismatches
